sentences.en: She felt the warmth of the sun on her skin.
sentences.zh: 她感受到阳光照在皮肤上的温暖。

sentences.en: He felt the warmth of the sun on his skin.
sentences.zh: 他感觉到阳光洒在他身上的暖意。

sentences.en: The landscape was bathed by the warmth of the sun.
sentences.zh: 这片土地沐浴在阳光的温暖之中。

senses.zh: 温暖，暖和,热情，热心,激动,诚恳
